:::{#sol-affine-linear-iff-practice}

Only for $c = 2$.
The map is

$$
f(\vx) = \sbmat{1 & -1 \\ 3 & 0} \vx + \sbmat{c - 2 \\ c^2 - 4},
$$

so its [offset](#def-affine-offset) is $\tp{(c - 2,\ c^2 - 4)}$.
By @thm-affine-linear-iff,
$f$ is linear exactly when both entries are $0$.
The first entry is $0$ only for $c = 2$,
and then the second entry is $2^2 - 4 = 0$ too.

:::
